استدررن (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَرْنَ (istadrarna) /is.tad.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَدَرَّ (istadarra)
# اُسْتُدْرِرْنَ (ustudrirna) /us.tud.rir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَدَرَّ (istadarra)
# اِسْتَدْرِرْنَ (istadrirna) /is.tad.rir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَدَرَّ (istadarra)
